searchText: I'm designing an allocator for a beacon state from scratch, <@881905303011086387> you just killed all the benefits of my *hashtree* library 😭 howso? it's not like it hashed the entire 40 layer triangle in one go, it does like 3-4 hashes in parallel, that's still possible The biggest benefit of the library is when you hash large continuous chunks. On epoch transitions these happen quite often. Same for some slices like balances per slot. But with the move to progressive containers those chunks become much smaller
